title: Yogi NFT
tagline: Yogi NFTs is the platform which can be leveraged to produce NFTs that are a proof of some accomplishment and merit.
description: Proof of accomplishment NFTs. Create an event detailing a task that you want to accomplish. Upload proofs of accomplishing that task and then become eligible for minting an NFT that proves that you are capable of doing the task you mentioned earlier. Another cool feature that I'm thinking of adding is recording your Livepeer livestreams and using those as the metadata for your proof-of-accomplishment NFTs
how_its_made: This project uses NFTPort API to convert metadata (media files) into NFTs and the details we get from the response of minting these NFTs are used to create an NFT gallery using the Covalent API. The livepeer APIs are almost completely set-up but the full integration hasn't been done yet.
